body.message:
We are very sorry to hear about your situation and understand the difficulties you are facing.

Unfortunately, we are unable to process a refund for the deposit you have paid. However, we can assist you in changing your booking dates for your next stay. This decision has been made by management due to the high number of cancellations, and as such, all guests are offered date changes only refunds are not available at this time.

We sincerely appreciate your understanding and hope to welcome you in Dubai once the situation allows.

Thank you for your cooperation.
